1479-2443-2841-7201.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-7201.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-3899-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-3899-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1818-1981-2415-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4559-4772-5147-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4559-4772-5147-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-2757-6970-7850.easyPrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain and a basic Forest.
2034-2757-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping two Cordyceps Infected tokens, untapping a basic Mountain and Forest.
Activate the Mountain and Forest by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.
2034-2757-6970-7850.notes: For maximum mana, make sure each Cordyceps Infected you sacrifice was tapped to untap lands first.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-549-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-4186-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

3081-3817-6797-7772.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

141-5686-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5686-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1090-3817-5147.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-1987-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Skullwinder.
When Donnie & April and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2034-5220-5632-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5632-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens and a Clue token
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2478-4195-4574-6918.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2639-3254-3634-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-3634-4050.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Venser and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Venser enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Venser and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-3634-4050.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

3197-6823-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6823-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2906-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5256-5643.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2906-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3025-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1652-4022-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Hidden Herbalists and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

413-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Grist trigger, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist tokens triggers once, while the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens and Blasting Station each trigger for each token created this way
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve all Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the planeswalker.

1429-3388-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, adding {R}.
Moritte of the Frost dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield as a copy of Lesser Masticore with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Lesser Masticore's ability any number of times to deal infinite damage to any creature(s).

63-1563-4321-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Wernog.
Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, causing you to create at least two Clue and two Food artifact tokens.
Activate three of the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

955-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
955-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

466-2034-4052.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
466-2034-4052.description:
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

803-2122-4997-5042.notablePrerequisites:
Mindless Automaton has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
"Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2122-4997-5042.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1912-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with haste.
539-1912-4499.description:
Acitvate the creature with haste by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking the creature with haste.
Repeat.
